messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: ur5e-manual, p. 233

21. Safety Functions Table “Reduced Description Affects Active” Input Reduced is not a mode. It is a change of settings initiated: SF parameter • internally by a safety plane/ boundary (starts when at 2cm of the plane and reduced settings are settings achieved within 2cm of the plane) or change • externally by use of an external input, which will achieve reduced settings within 500ms of the triggering input. Robot When the external connections are Low, Reduced Mode is initiated. “Reduced Active” means that all reduced limits are ACTIVE. Reduced is not a safety function. Reduced is a means of parameterization of safety functions. Reduced is a state change affecting the settings of the following safety functions: joint position, joint speed, TCP pose, TCP speed, TCP force, momentum, power, stopping time, & stopping distance.
